title: Midweek UX & Ops Snapshot — quick signal scrub
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Elena, Ravi, Jordan (10m)

Purpose: quick midweek triage — focus on two live rollouts, one telemetry gap, and a UI regression on panel filters.

High-level:
- Canary A: rollout to 5% east-us completed. Latency stable, but observed 3x higher trace spikes at 95th for panel render. Possible root: client-side bundle change + analytics probe causing serialization delay.
- Feature flag churn: staging flag FF-ux-fastfilter is toggled frequently by QA. Need guard rails to avoid mix in canary traffic.
- Analytics ingestion: missing event for "panel.toggle_group" for ~12 hours yesterday — causes gaps in feature-usage-driven rollout decisions.

Detailed notes by thread:

UI / Panel Filters
- Symptom: users (internal QA) see blank state for filters after navigating back from deep link ~10% of attempts.
- Repro: Marcus reproduced on Chrome 114 on macOS with panel with >12 widgets. Reproduction steps in GH issue.
- Suspected cause: debounce change in client SDK (PR 1842) + quick navigation path clearing local state before hydrate.
- Short-term mitigation: revert debounce to 150ms for canary cohort only. Elena to open hotfix PR with feature-flag gating (ETA: today EOD).
- Long-term: add small e2e that navigates deep-link -> back -> assert filters persisted (Ravi owns, ETA: sprint+1).

Rollouts / Routing
- Canary A (panel-rollout-v2): 5% east-us, 0% other regions. Observed region-specific trace spikes.
  - Action: increase sampling for affected region to get finer traces. Jordan to update sampling config and coordinate with SRE (ENG-11290) — ETA: tomorrow morning.
  - If no improvement in 24h, fallback to panel-rollout-v1 for east-us.
- Canary B (analytics-based ordering): paused after ingestion gap detected.
  - Reason: missing event makes model decide low-confidence ordering; risk of ordering regressions.
  - Action: keep paused until ingestion restored + run offline sim on last 7 days to validate behavior (Elena + Data Eng).

Telemetry / Observability
- Missing event: panel.toggle_group absent for a 12-hour window between 2027-05-02 02:00 – 14:00 UTC.
  - Root lead: investigation points to Kafka topic throughput spike and connector backpressure.
  - Temporary: implement local fallback counter emitted from frontend so we at least capture counts in the UI payload (Aisha to prototype; if ok, ship as opt-in flag on staging).
- Tracing: 95th percentile spikes — need flamegraph capture for slow render path. Marcus will attach flamegraph run to GH issue and drop sample traces into Confluence page.

Action items (owner — due):
- Elena: open hotfix PR to revert debounce in canary flag (FF-debounce-temp) — due 2027-05-03 EOD.
- Jordan: bump trace sampling for east-us, sync with SRE on forwarding collector — due 2027-05-04 AM.
- Ravi: add e2e scenario for deep-link filter persistence, add to CI smoke suite — due 2027-05-14.
- Aisha: prototype frontend fallback counter and spec for opt-in telemetry fallback (write short RFC) — due 2027-05-06.
- Marcus: capture and attach flamegraphs + 10 example traces to GH issue and Confluence — due 2027-05-04.
- Elena + Data Eng: run offline sim for analytics ordering on last 7 days, report delta vs control — due 2027-05-05.

Blockers / open questions:
- Can we temporarily route east-us panel traffic through a slightly higher-memory worker pool? Cost impact unknown — need SRE signoff.
- Is the frontend fallback counter acceptable from a privacy/compliance perspective? Flagged for legal review (linked artifact to compliance ticket TKT-554).
- Which rollout metric should be primary for analytics-based ordering? Current weights: uptime/latency + usage — need product decision.

Notes to self / random fragments (informal):
- QA kept toggling FF-ux-fastfilter -> causes noisy metrics; consider a temp policy: require an owner to flip flags in duration < 10m.
- Keep an eye on the headline: "panel render 95p spike" — if it shows in next 12h, escalate to on-call SRE.
- Small win: panel telemetry retention query optimized — cost down ~6% in query scans (thanks Data Eng).

Next check-in: Friday morning async update. If any hotfixes are merged, announce in #console-rollouts and ping PagerDuty if region regressions appear.

Quick links / references:
- GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/3245
- Hotfix PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1842
- Confluence trace notebook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/trace-notebook-2027-05
